posts.title: Black, White, and Red
posts.description: The interracial crime-fighting duo is a trope so archetypal that it’s barely even a trope any more. Robert Culp and Bill Cosby as freewheeling, globe-trotting secret agent pals in I Spy (1965-1968) were an early example.
